FM Madhesh Kumar of Pondicherry is having a great tournament in Chennai. In the 1st round, he defeated GM Gharibyan Mamikon; in the 5th round, he defeated IM Defromont Benjamin, and now he is playing against IM Apoorv Kamble. In this video, Madhesh breaks down his game against Apoorv.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Devansh Singh
